title: Daily inactivity flagging of anchor license requests

outcomes.statement: An audited daily inactivityFlagging job after analyticsSync sets flagged_inactive on the anchor LicenseRequest of each open assignment whose person has more than 30 days of inactivity against lag-aware data_through, returns flagged_inactive to active when activity resumes, leaves other states untouched and creates no proposals; 60/90 days are display filters only.
outcomes.demo: Activity ending 31 and 29 days before data_through flags only the first anchor request with a RequestTransition and audit entry; renewed activity returns a flagged request to active with its own transition and audit; reruns change nothing, concurrent manual transitions resolve cleanly, other states and companies are untouched, analytics lag alone never flags.

uncertainties.statement: Daily flagging and un-flagging ownership is canonical.
uncertainties.resolution: DEC-SMP-028, BR-16 and US-074 AC1-AC3 require inactivityFlagging after analyticsSync: active -> flagged_inactive for more than 30 days; flagged_inactive -> active on renewed activity; all other states left alone. 60/90 are display-only. No proposals are created.

uncertainties.statement: Concurrent job runs or a manual transition racing the job.
uncertainties.resolution: Conditional UPDATE on the expected current state (active for flagging, flagged_inactive for renewed-activity return) in one transaction with RequestTransition and audit. Real-DB fixtures prove rerun and manual-transition race safety for both directions.

uncertainties.statement: US-026 and US-072 prerequisites and shared classifier are available.
uncertainties.resolution: SPRINT_PLAN and terminal done records confirm both prerequisites complete. packages/domain/src/usage/inactivity.ts exports evaluateInactivity and hasPositiveVendorActivity; inactivity is strictly >30 and no_data is separate. Classifier and apps/web/src/modules/usage/repository.ts remain read-only. Falsifier: a missing export or changed policy would require deviation and coordination through Francisco.

uncertainties.statement: Schedule registration and runtime composition must include the new job without duplicating scheduler infrastructure.
uncertainties.resolution: packages/domain/src/jobs/schedule.ts has analyticsSync at 10:15 UTC; apps/worker/src/runtime.ts registers every schedule and requires a per-JobName idempotency window; jobs/deferred.ts composes handlers. Budget covers after-analytics daily ordering, daily key, handler wiring, runtime schedule oracle and compatibility fixes. No new service or migration.

uncertainties.statement: Tenant-scoped atomic writes and real-DB race fixtures have existing seams.
uncertainties.resolution: packages/db/src/request-transition.ts locks the company-scoped request and conditionally updates state with transition and audit in the same caller transaction. US-074 owns job persistence and relevant transition changes; conflicting states must yield a clean skipped outcome. packages/db/src/testing/postgres-container.ts supports SMP_TEST_POSTGRES_CLUSTER_URL; fixtures must use the CHG-067 shared cluster and never private containers. Falsifier: absent shared-cluster bootstrap or incorrect tenant joins must be repaired within scope before verification.

uncertainties.statement: Parallel US-073 integration and consolidated sessions are bounded.
uncertainties.resolution: US-073 owns batch action/UI/proposal persistence; US-074 owns worker, schedule, request transitions and audit writes. One implementer with task checkpoints; one reused scoped reviewer plus fresh adversarial reviewer. Freeze mutation base only after readiness/design/plan entry approvals. Full gates hold /tmp/smp-full-gate.lock, caffeinate -i pnpm check; never remove sibling lock. Second sibling rebases, retains both ledgers in ts order, records rewritten SHA map deviation, checks feedback order and readiness, then fast-forwards. No shared classifier/read-model change without deviation and Francisco coordination.

uncertainties.statement: Touched files and mutation routing fit the approved size.
uncertainties.resolution: 18 expected files includes worker job and tests, deferred handler and tests, runtime and integration oracle, domain schedule and tests, DB persistence/transition seams and tests/exports, testing guidance if a critical path changes, readiness/design/plan and ledger. Three estimated mutation shards inherited from canonical partition; preflight discovers actual IDs and count. Count mismatch is recorded as deviation and actuals, without editing approved payload. No tooling expansion. CHG-069 touched-shard previews, tasks+1 rounds, <=30 preview minutes; slow DB shards once in final preview unless touched by repairs.
